Name: Fatewatcher
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: Serving as leaders and oracles, the fatewatchers are keepers of lore and magic. They are highly proficient spellcasters and mediators, experts in keeping an even temper, and using hushed tongues.

traits.name: Hyperlinear Processing
traits.description: The nephilim uses their connection to the Abiding Heart to increase their mental capabilities, allowing them to concentrate on multiple spells at once: as long as their combined level does not add up to 6 or higher, the nephilim can concentrate on any number of different spells (cantrips count as 1st level). They make concentration checks for all of their spells as if they were one, succeeding or failing together.

traits.name: Rite of Calculation (1/Day)
traits.description: When the nephilim casts a spell, they can draw knowledge from the Abiding Heart to cast that spell as if the spell slot used for it was 7th level.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: The nephilim is a 10th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Intelligence. They have the following spells prepared:

actions.name: Quarterstaff of Mental Shock
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Hypercast (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The nephilim casts two spells with a casting time of one action or faster, as long as their combined spell level does not equal 6 or higher (cantrips count as 1st level).

bonus_actions.name: Subdermal Illumination
bonus_actions.description: The nephilim causes its body to magically produce bright light out to 20 feet, with dim light twice as far, or causes this light to be extinguished. This light is treated as a spell with a level equal to the nephilim’s proficiency bonus.
